synergies.name: Comet Breakup
synergies.description: A comet doesn't burst, it breaks up. Under Nova Form your attacks from other classes go out all eight ways at once: you take the way you aimed, and seven Fragments of You streak out the other seven from where you stood, each setting the spell off where it lands with a copy's weaker status effects. A spell laid on the ground stays a plain nova.

modifies.name: Comet Breakup
modifies.summary: seven Fragments of You take the other seven ways round you
